en.NAME: ServiceWand · Render Plans Section
en.DESCRIPTION: Controls whether the plans section is visible in this monoblock.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Default Billing Cycle
en.DESCRIPTION: Selects which billing cycle is active when the pricing section first renders.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Dynamic Pricing Enabled
en.DESCRIPTION: Opts this block into loading Core PIM pricing. When false or when loading fails, the static plan fields remain the rendered fallback.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Pricing API Base
en.DESCRIPTION: Core PIM API base path or origin. The runtime removes a trailing /api and posts to /public/{organization}/catalog/price-comparison.json.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Pricing Organization
en.DESCRIPTION: Core PIM organization code used in the public catalog URL.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Pricing Product Type Code
en.DESCRIPTION: Core PIM product type to request, for example SERVICEWAND_SAAS, SERVICEWAND_SAAS_EXT, or SERVICEWAND_SAAS_ROUTING_TOKENS.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Pricing Sort Attribute Code
en.DESCRIPTION: Product attribute used to sort plans before falling back to amount.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Pricing Price Type Code
en.DESCRIPTION: Core PIM price type code for the request.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Pricing Price Attribute Code
en.DESCRIPTION: Core PIM price attribute used to filter prices.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Pricing Price Attribute Values
en.DESCRIPTION: Comma-separated price attribute values used by Core PIM filtering.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Pricing Currency
en.DESCRIPTION: Currency attribute value requested from Core PIM.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Dynamic Pricing Purchase URL
en.DESCRIPTION: CTA destination used by dynamically rendered plans.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Dynamic Pricing Buy Label
en.DESCRIPTION: CTA label for plans with numeric pricing.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Dynamic Pricing Contact Label
en.DESCRIPTION: CTA and price label for custom/contact pricing.

en.NAME: Plans · Dynamic Pricing Feature List Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Accessible label for dynamically rendered plan feature lists. This is a localized CMS fallback, not a JavaScript string.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Dynamic Pricing Error Mode
en.DESCRIPTION: Currently only fallback is supported: keep the static CMS-authored cards if Core PIM loading fails.

en.NAME: Plans · Pricing Eyebrow
en.DESCRIPTION: Small uppercase label above the pricing headline.

en.NAME: Plans · Pricing Headline
en.DESCRIPTION: Main headline for the pricing plans section.

en.NAME: Plans · Pricing Lede
en.DESCRIPTION: Introductory paragraph below the pricing headline.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Render Add-ons Section
en.DESCRIPTION: Controls whether the dynamic add-ons section is visible in this monoblock.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Collapsable
en.DESCRIPTION: When true, shows the add-ons teaser band and toggle so the add-on cards can collapse behind the section header.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Collapsed by Default
en.DESCRIPTION: Initial add-ons body state when Collapsable is true. Ignored when Collapsable is false.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Summary Add-ons Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Localized label used by JS in the generated collapsed summary after the add-on count.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Summary Categories Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Localized label used by JS in the generated collapsed summary after the category count.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Summary From Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Localized prefix used by JS before the lowest numeric add-on price in the generated collapsed summary.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Pricing Catalog Specs
en.DESCRIPTION: Semicolon-separated dynamic catalogs. Format per item: productTypeCode|priceTypeCode|priceAttributeCode|priceAttributeValues|fixtureUrl. The fixtureUrl part stays empty in CMS production.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Dynamic Pricing Purchase URL
en.DESCRIPTION: Shared purchase/contact URL used by every add-on card CTA.

en.NAME: ServiceWand · Dynamic Pricing Buy Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Localized buy label shown on dynamic add-on card CTAs for numeric add-on pricing.

en.NAME: Addons · Add-ons Eyebrow
en.DESCRIPTION: Small uppercase label above the add-ons heading.

en.NAME: Addons · Add-ons Heading
en.DESCRIPTION: Main heading for the add-ons section.

en.NAME: Addons · Add-ons Lede
en.DESCRIPTION: Introductory paragraph for the add-ons section.
